module_title: Birth of the WTO, History, and Core Principles
introduction: After WWII, the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was created to boost international trade. However, GATT had several loopholes and lacked enforcement power. To fix this, a much stronger and permanent institution—the WTO—was born.

core_concepts.title: From GATT to WTO
core_concepts.description: GATT (1947) dealt ONLY with trade in 'Goods'. After a massive 8-year negotiation process known as the 'Uruguay Round' (1986-1994), member nations signed the 'Marrakesh Agreement' on April 15, 1994. This officially gave birth to the WTO on January 1, 1995.

core_concepts.title: What is the WTO?
core_concepts.description: The WTO is the only global international organization dealing with the 'rules of trade' between nations. Its primary goal is to ensure that trade flows as smoothly, predictably, and freely as possible. Its headquarters is in 'Geneva, Switzerland'.

core_concepts.title: Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) Principle
core_concepts.description: This is the cornerstone of the WTO. It means 'non-discrimination'. If you grant a special favor (like a lower customs duty) to one country, you MUST grant that exact same favor to 'ALL' other WTO member countries. You cannot play favorites.

core_concepts.title: National Treatment Principle
core_concepts.description: Once a foreign product has entered your country's domestic market, you must treat it exactly the same as you treat your own locally produced goods. (You cannot apply higher domestic taxes on a foreign car compared to an Indian car).

important_entities.name: Marrakesh Agreement
important_entities.significance: Signed in Marrakesh, Morocco, this treaty established the WTO. A highly repeated exam question is: 'The WTO was the outcome of which round of GATT talks?' Answer: The Uruguay Round.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Statement: 'The WTO is a specialized agency of the United Nations.' This is FALSE. While the IMF and World Bank are UN agencies, the WTO is a completely independent organization outside the UN system.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The name 'Most-Favored' sounds like you are picking a favorite, but it actually means the exact opposite: 'Treat everyone as your most favored' (i.e., treat everyone equally).

exam_strategy_tips: Direct Question: 'On which date did the WTO replace GATT?' Answer: January 1, 1995.
